The mutation after my last commit produced no durable ledger change: the two files I wrote were `MEMORY.md` and a new memory note under `/home/axel/.claude-api/projects/.../memory/`, which git reports as **outside the ledger repository** — it is the persistent agent memory store, its own durable mechanism, and cannot be committed with `$HORIZON_GIT`.

Everything I authored inside the ledger is committed and byte-verified: all eight paths hash-match `HEAD:<path>`, and all seven commits are ancestors of HEAD. The scratch probe directory is gone from disk and untracked. p2 has confirmed both my corrections and reports its own file unaffected.

The final report above stands unchanged.
